spawnAgent

protected void spawnAgent(AgentId id,
                          Term agentType,
                          Struct argsList)
                   throws SpawnAgentException
Spawns an agent Actually, the basic TuCSoN infrastructure supports directly two types of agent: Java Agent and tuProlog logic agent. Java agents are characterised by the type java(ClassName), Prolog agents are characterised by the type prolog(TheoryFile).

Parameters:
id - is the agent identifier
agentType - is the agent type.
argsList - is the list of the boot arguments.
Throws:
SpawnAgentException - if it is not possible to spawn an agent with those characteristics
